config.engineering_criterion: At least.95balanced accuracy on EVERYtask; ambitious engineering target, not guaranteed horizon

recipe.training_recipe: One32-pair task batch/update; uniform7cycle versus interleaved contour/other12cycle; task-local streams270001+100003*(task_index+1)
recipe.checkpoint_selection: Highest minimum task BA, then mean task OVR-AUC; exact ties earliest checkpoint
recipe.decision_rule: Fixed argmax for every task; no test tuning

config.uncertainty: 1000 source-image-cluster or generated-pair bootstrap replicates per overall task; difficulty points and class-wise Wilson intervals; single seed
